About Us

Meet The Innovative Company Behind The QR Code Photo Sharing Revolution

GUESTPIX pioneered the QR code and private gallery concept, reshaping how the world collects and shares event memories.

GUESTPIX™ was born from a simple but powerful idea: to make reliving special moments easier, more joyful, and less compromised by tech limitations.

Founded in Adelaide, South Australia in June 2022 by husband-and-wife duo Warwick and Carla Groves, GUESTPIX™ launched into the world with no blueprint to follow and no competitors to imitate – just a belief in the magic of candid, high-quality memories and a vision to simplify how we collect and share them.

The idea was as fresh as it was bold: use a QR code to let guests instantly upload their photos and videos to a private, full-quality digital gallery. No apps. No hashtags. No social media chaos. Just beautiful, authentic memories – shared privately, securely, and effortlessly.

Fast forward to March 2025, and GUESTPIX™ has become a global memory-collecting movement. Over 150,000 events across the world have trusted us to help preserve their most meaningful moments – from weddings and milestone birthdays to corporate events, baby showers, quinceañeras, and even memorials.

Without a roadmap, we built our own path – powered by curiosity, resilience, and a deep respect for the moments that matter most.

If there’s an occasion worth celebrating or memories worth sharing, GUESTPIX™ has it covered!

Meet The Founders of GUESTPIX™, here.

Collecting memories has never been so simple.

How it Works
